name: Roar：Return Our Legends
detailed_description:
preface:

As one of the young people of this generation, the golden era of economic growth in the past was not enjoyable. In the current era, we are once again brothers with cows and horses. The future era has been arranged in advance by (such as mortgage loans). But unfortunately, Huangyang, Nal, and the 4+4 speed communication doctors are only favored. What should we do with them? But instead of getting lost in a sea of people, I feel uncomfortable not to vomit.

So I decided to travel to another parallel time and space, building a brand new era, one where the future is in my hands and hope is still visible, and the story unfolds from there. Yanzu, don't hurry up and let me explain it to you.

-------------------------------------------------------------------

Game introduction and story background:

Pangu was born in the world, and N ü wa was born in Pangu. After repairing time and space, the remaining Taichu Tianshi scattered throughout the land of China

Nurturing the Monkey King Wukong, Venom Awakens the Void

The Tathagata is unkind, snatching the Purple Cloud Elemental God and refining it into a wick to help him live forever

Wukong realizes the combination of virtual spirit and soul, causing chaos in the Heavenly Palace. But his technique was immature, he was defeated, he was banished to the mortal world, and his brothers fell apart

Wukong is a wanderer in the human world, at large but also happy

The sky and earth are vast, fallen leaves bring messages, and ancient Buddha personally arrives by burning lamps

To save his beloved, Wukong carried the Chaos Cauldron to other parallel time and space, hoping to restore his divine power. Lin Po Tian, the person who finally found the mandate of heaven, and the two of them have gone through a long time and witnessed the arrival of a new era together

After much thought, Po Tian wanted to go back to his student days and unravel some of his emotional knots. With the help of Wukong, Po Tian returned to his long lost high school days

When campus life first appeared, it was still so beautiful, pure and beautiful, carefree every day

I thought that with knowledge of the future, I could wield the wind and rain

But the development of things was unexpected, like a big tree growing a new branch, and it's impossible to predict where the new branch will grow

And with a mysterious letter, Po Tian gradually came into contact with something that had been troubling him back then. It turned out that there was a complex conspiracy under the floating ice. Will he stand idly by or lead himself into the situation this time? Inviting you to witness

A very cool visual novel game, players will follow the young Lin Po Tian to return to their student days, but go through completely different people and events in their lives, and return after experiencing thousands of sails

-------------------------------------------------------------------

Main roles:

Lin Po Tian:

Let me tell you a hammer, the absolute protagonist. Because of his handsome appearance, he was once chased all the way from the North Railway Station to Tianfu New Area (with no eyes?). All the brothers he slept with agreed (all in the same dormitory)

In addition to being sharp tongued and highly motherly, he is also very approachable, refined and easy-going. Pay attention to one thing: if someone does not offend me, I will not offend. If someone does offend me, you can directly surrender yourself

If you don't hang the whole world, it's useless even if you let his mother come, because

He doesn't have a mother. Within the four seas, the only one who can pull him is Su Xuening. It's not pretending, it really can't beat

After crossing the timeline of the past, he gradually grew up and became the most wanted criminal by the Chengdu Municipal Government. But it's not him who's at fault, it's that era of 'b' that started a wildfire

Su Xuening:

Let me tell you a hammer... Hmm, let's just talk briefly

Bing Xue is intelligent, naturally beautiful, enjoys playing games (and breaking through the sky), and enjoys reading anime and novels. That's it. It's still the top few in the whole school. You can learn it

After being provoked, the cold air is chilling, but it won't be frostbitten in the sky. He also thinks it's the best air conditioning in summer. On a hot day, sitting there still requires wearing a coat and not making a sound. Do you think it's ridiculous

The national women's martial arts champion, affectionately referred to by Po Tian as the "National Clothing Wrist Hero"

Proud and aloof in personality, like a rose with thorns, only to be viewed from afar and not to be violated or played with

Don't get too close to strangers. If you don't believe me, go ahead and try it out. Look at her and she might end up killing you!

But to be honest, as a Sichuan girl, she is really gentle and gentle. Where is she

Xu Wan:

When she was in elementary school, she had an extremely happy childhood. She thought her future would be a complete family and a vivid life. But in the Year of the Rat, heaven mercilessly deprived her of everything and plunged her into the abyss

The fragmentation of her original family has left her physically and mentally devastated. Her experiences far exceed those of her peers, and her hardships far exceed those of normal people. Surviving is already a miracle (the characters are quite complex, and it's also a miracle that I can write about them)

But the ups and downs lead to a turning point, and the appearance of a mysterious person is a gift to her tenacious and resilient personality

Actually, I guess there's also a contribution to breaking the sky

The traces of maturity do not mean that she is not a lively and agile elf

Zhao Xiyue:

Unknown origin, I only remember growing up with Po Tian since childhood and being his childhood sweetheart and good brother

Ancient and quirky, lively and lovely. Strong hands-on ability, making a good dish (and various delicacies), a legendary alumnus of New Oriental, like a food god descending to earth. With this little sister, why would a husband ask for anything more?

Treating Po Tian as his only relative, he harbored great hostility towards women who were close to him and praised Su Xuening by name. The two of them often started fighting when they met, without any hesitation, and within three steps, blood would splatter all over their bodies

Fu Yanqing:

Rich second generation, doesn't like women, um... no, doesn't like a woman from a similar family background to her childhood sweetheart

One of the Three Musketeers of Haichuan, a good brother who breaks through the heavens. Their fragrance is similar, and the two are like siblings, with a close friendship that has lasted for a lifetime

Coming out to rely on the background, the real identity is after the former Qin Emperor Fu Jian, a prestigious family with immense power

Jinggai Biao:

Slightly cool temperament, shy and silly. A student from Haichuan Middle School, Brother Po Tian, and one of the three swordsmen of Haichuan

Favorite profession: Chinese captain. Alas, everyone has desires in their hearts. If they weren't lonely, who would rush every day. (Listen to the manhole cover and eat this black wolfberry first.)

Favorite song: Listen to Mom, this child's main theme is rebellion. The abstract native family has created a high talent for competitive gaming. It is a product of the collision between the old era full of prejudice against internet addicted teenagers and the new era of rapid development of the internet, short videos, and live streaming

Fertransy：

Central African orphans, kind, resilient and humorous, with small bodies carrying big dreams

Like smoke:

Before crossing over, she was a beautiful roommate who shared a room with me, like a mature and considerate confidante. After crossing through, it turned out to be Xuening's aunt.

I see that Auntie, you still have some charm

Mysterious person:

-------------------------------------------------------------------

Regarding others:

Story: The plot is full of ups and downs, the twists and turns are full of wit, and the dialogue is both witty and humorous

Fine arts: exquisite standing paintings, scenes CG

Voice: A voice over of a character that makes the crotch cool, and a heartwarming soundtrack. moon
